```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(performance)
library(DHARMa)

my_theme <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(family = "Helvetica", face = "bold"),
    axis.title  = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
    axis.text   = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
    legend.text = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
    legend.title= element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
    strip.text  = element_text(family = "Helvetica")
  )

slant_label_scale = c(
    "Far left"  = "blue",
    "Left"       = "lightblue",
    "Center"     = "purple",
    "Right"      = "salmon",
    "Far right" = "red"
  )

```


```{r load}
df <- read_csv("../data/puppets/processed/27-12/wide.csv")
df <- df %>% filter(puppet_state == "drifting")

df$cond_dir <- relevel(factor(df$cond_dir), ref="static")
df$puppet_cond <- relevel(factor(df$puppet_cond), ref="(0, 0)")

df$slant_start_label <- recode(
  as.character(df$slant_start),
  "1" = "right",
  "0" = "center",
  "-1" = "left",
  .default = "random"
)
df$slant_target_label <- recode(
  as.character(df$slant_target),
  "1" = "right",
  "0" = "center",
  "-1" = "left",
  .default = "random"
)

```

```{r data plots}

ggplot(filter(df), aes(x = mean_rec_slant)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ slant_label) +
  theme_minimal()

subids <- df %>%
  filter(puppet_cond == "(0, -1)") %>%
  pull(puppet_id) %>%
  unique() %>%
  head(10)

p_sub <- df %>% filter(puppet_id %in% subids)

ggplot(p_sub, aes(depth, rec_mean_diff)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ puppet_id) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r util model spec }

util_dat = filter(df, slant_start_label == "random")
util_dat$depth_sc <- util_dat$depth / max(util_dat$depth)

md_util <- lmer(mean_rec_slant ~ utility * (depth_sc + slant_label + source) + depth_sc * slant_label + (1 + depth_sc|puppet_id), data=util_dat)
md_util1 <- lmer(mean_rec_slant ~ utility * (depth + slant_label + source) + (1|puppet_id), data=util_dat)

AIC(md_util, md_util1)

r2(md_util)
summary(md_util)

```
```{r util marginal trends and means}

tr_util <- emtrends(md_util, ~ slant_label * source, by = "utility", var="depth_sc", at = list(source="video"))
summary(tr_util, infer=TRUE)


tr_util.contrast <- emtrends(
  md_util,
  ~ utility,
  var = "depth_sc",
  by=c("slant_label","source")
)
pairs(tr_util.contrast)

#plot(tr_util.contrast,comparisons = TRUE)

emm_util <- emmeans(md_util, ~ utility | slant_label + source, at=list(depth=c(200)))
pairs(emm_util)

```

```{r util viz}

emm_df <- emmip(
  md_util,
  slant_label * source ~ depth_sc | utility,
  at = list(
    depth_sc  = c(min(util_dat$depth_sc), max(util_dat$depth_sc)),
    source = c("video", "homepage")
  ),
  plotit = FALSE
)

p_util <- ggplot(
  emm_df,
  aes(
    x = depth_sc, y = yvar,
    color = slant_label,
    linetype = source,
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(y = "Predicted MRS",x ="Depth") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ utility,
    labeller = labeller(
      utility = c(`TRUE` = "Utility = TRUE", `FALSE` = "Utility = FALSE")
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = slant_label_scale, breaks = c("Far left", "Left", "Center", "Right", "Far right")) +
  my_theme +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

ggsave("util_estimated.png", p_util)
p_util


```

```{r util diagnostics}

res_util <- simulateResiduals(md_util)
plot(res_util)
testUniformity(res_util)
testOutliers(res_util)


mf <- model.frame(md_util)   # ensures same rows/order as the fitted model

res_by_depth <- recalculateResiduals(res_util, group = mf$depth)

testTemporalAutocorrelation(
  res_by_depth,
  time = sort(unique(mf$depth))
)

```


```{r baseline bias model}

bas_dat <- filter(df, slant_start_label == "random" & utility == TRUE)
bas_dat <- bas_dat |>
  group_by(puppet_slant) |>
  summarise(mean_rec_slant = mean(mean_rec_slant, na.rm = TRUE))

md_bas <- lm(mean_rec_slant ~ puppet_slant, data=bas_dat)
summary(md_bas)

df$mean_rec_corr <- df$mean_rec_slant - predict(md_bas, newdata = data.frame(puppet_slant = df$puppet_slant))

```

```{r baseline biz}

r2(md_bas)

# Model predictions
p_bas <- emmip(
  md_bas,
  ~ puppet_slant,
  at = list(puppet_slant = c(-1, 1)),
  plotit = FALSE
)

# Build plot manually for full control
ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = bas_dat,
    aes(x = puppet_slant, y = mean_rec_slant),
    size=1,
    color="grey70"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = p_bas,
    aes(x = puppet_slant, y = yvar),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(y = "MRS", x="Puppet Slant") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 0.5)) +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio=1,
    text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

```

```{r modeling}
md_cor_dat <- filter(df, cond_group != "static" & cond_group != "random")

md_dat <- filter(df, cond_group != "random")
md_dat <- md_dat %>%
  group_by(puppet_id) %>%
  mutate(
    y0 = mean_rec_slant[depth == 0][1]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

md_dat$depth_sc <- md_dat$depth / max(md_dat$depth)
md_dat$bas_diff <- md_dat$mean_rec_slant - md_dat$y0

md <- lmer(mean_rec_slant ~ 0 + slant_start_label + depth_sc + puppet_cond:depth_sc + source + (1 + depth_sc |puppet_id), data=md_dat)
md_corrected <- lmer(mean_rec_corr ~ depth * puppet_cond + source + (1|puppet_id), data=md_cor_dat)

r2(md_corrected)
r2(md)

summary(md)

```

```{r contrasts}

tr <- emtrends(
  md,
  ~ puppet_cond:slant_start_label,
  var = "depth_sc",
  nesting=NULL,
  lmerTest.limit = 266325
)

summary(tr, infer=TRUE)

makeK <- function(tr_obj, plus, minus) {
  lev <- levels(tr_obj@grid$puppet_cond)
  k <- setNames(rep(0, length(lev)), lev)
  k[plus]  <-  1
  k[minus] <- -1
  k
}

K <- list(
  rad_from0_R_vs_static_0 =
    makeK(tr, "(0, 1)", "(0, 0)"),

  rad_from0_L_vs_static_0 =
    makeK(tr, "(0, -1)", "(0, 0)"),

  derad_from1_L_vs_static_1 =
    makeK(tr, "(1, 0)", "(1, 1)"),

  derad_fromm1_R_vs_static_m1 =
    makeK(tr, "(-1, 0)", "(-1, -1)"),

  inv_fromm1_R_vs_static_m1 =
    makeK(tr, "(-1, 1)", "(-1, -1)"),

  inv_from1_L_vs_static_1 =
    makeK(tr, "(1, -1)", "(1, 1)")
)


res <- contrast(tr, K, adjust = "holm", by = "slant_start_label")
summary(res, infer = TRUE)
plot(res)
contrast(
  res,
  method = "pairwise",
  adjust = "holm",
  at=list(slant_start_label="center")
)

```

```{r plotting data}

md_dat_agg <- md_dat |>
  group_by(depth, cond_group, cond_dir, source, slant_start_label, slant_target_label) |>
  summarise(mean_rec_slant = mean(mean_rec_slant, na.rm = TRUE), mean_rec_corr = mean(mean_rec_corr, na.rm = TRUE))

md_dat_agg2 <- md_dat_agg %>%
  mutate(
    cond_type = ifelse(cond_group == "static", "Static", "Drifting"),
    cond_dir2 = ifelse(cond_type == "Static", "Static", as.character(cond_dir))
  )

p_md_dat <- ggplot(data=md_dat_agg, aes(x=depth, y=mean_rec_slant, color=slant_target_label)) + 
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(source~slant_start_label) +
  my_theme +
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)

p_md_dat_corr <- ggplot(data=md_dat_agg, aes(x=depth, y=mean_rec_corr, color=cond_dir, linetype=source)) + 
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(~cond_group) +
  my_theme +
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)

end_raw <- md_dat_agg2 %>%
  filter(cond_type == "Drifting") %>%
  group_by(source, slant_start_label, cond_group, cond_dir, cond_dir2) %>%
  filter(depth == max(depth, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2) Plot
p_raw <- ggplot(md_dat_agg2, aes(x = depth, y = mean_rec_slant)) +

  # Static baseline (thick black)
  geom_line(
    data = subset(md_dat_agg2, cond_type == "Static"),
    aes(group = interaction(cond_group, slant_start_label)),
    colour = "grey10",
    linewidth = 1.4,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +

  # Drifting conditions (colored by direction, dashed)
  geom_line(
    data = subset(md_dat_agg2, cond_type == "Drifting"),
    aes(colour = cond_dir2, group = interaction(cond_group, cond_dir, source)),
    linewidth = 0.95,
    linetype = "22",
    lineend = "round"
  ) +

  # 3) End labels for drift target/condition (pick ONE label mapping below)
  geom_label_repel(
    data = end_raw,
    aes(
      colour = cond_dir2,
      label = slant_target_label
    ),
    direction = "y",
    nudge_x = 2,
    hjust = 0,
    segment.alpha = 0.35,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  facet_grid(source ~ slant_start_label) +
  labs(
    x = "Depth",
    y = "MRS",
    colour = "Drift direction"
  ) +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    aspect.ratio = 0.6,
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 25, 5.5, 5.5)  # room for labels on right
  )

p_raw
p_md_dat
p_md_dat_corr

```

```{r plotting contrasts}

df_res <- as.data.frame(summary(res, infer = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(
    # what start label this contrast *should* belong to
    start_expected = case_when(
      str_detect(contrast, "from0")  ~ "center",
      str_detect(contrast, "fromm1") ~ "left",
      str_detect(contrast, "from1")  ~ "right",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  # keep only matched rows
  filter(is.na(start_expected) | slant_start_label == start_expected) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      str_detect(contrast, "_R_") ~ "Right",
      str_detect(contrast, "_L_") ~ "Left",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    cond_group = case_when(
      str_detect(contrast, "^rad_")   ~ "Radicalisation",
      str_detect(contrast, "^derad_") ~ "Deradicalisation",
      str_detect(contrast, "^inv_")   ~ "Inversion",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

df_res <- df_res %>%
  mutate(
    cond_group = factor(
      cond_group,
      levels = c("Inversion", "Radicalisation", "Deradicalisation")
    )
  )

dir_cols <- c(
  "Left"  = slant_label_scale[["Far left"]],
  "Right" = slant_label_scale[["Far right"]]
)


ggplot(
  df_res,
  aes(
    x = estimate,
    y = cond_group,
    colour = direction
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower.CL, xmax = upper.CL),
    height = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Trend contrast (drifting − matched static)",
    y = NULL,
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dir_cols, breaks = c("Left", "Right")) +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    aspect.ratio=0.25
  )


```

```{r plot m}

p_md_df <- emmip(
  md,
  puppet_cond ~ depth_sc | slant_start_label,
  CIs = TRUE,
  at = list(depth_sc = c(min(md_dat$depth_sc), max(md_dat$depth_sc))), 
  var = "depth_sc",
  plotit = FALSE
)

cond_lookup <- md_dat %>%
  distinct(puppet_cond, cond_group, cond_dir, slant_target_label)

p_md_df <- p_md_df %>%
  left_join(cond_lookup, by = "puppet_cond")


p_plot <- p_md_df %>%
  mutate(
    is_static = cond_group == "static",          # adjust if needed
    group_type = ifelse(is_static, "Static", "Drifting")
  )

p_plot <- p_plot %>%
  mutate(
    slant_start_label = factor(
      slant_start_label,
      levels = c("left","center","right"),
      labels = c("Starting slant: Left", "Starting slant: Center", "Starting slant: Right")
    )
  )

library(ggrepel)

p_plot_end <- p_plot %>%
  group_by(slant_start_label, puppet_cond) %>%
  filter(depth_sc == max(depth_sc)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_plot_end <- p_plot_end %>%
  mutate(label_nudge_y = ifelse(slant_start_label == "Starting slant: Right" &
                                 slant_target_label == "center", 0.08, 0))

dir_cols <- c(
  "left"  = slant_label_scale[["Far left"]],
  "right" = slant_label_scale[["Far right"]]
)

ggplot(p_plot, aes(x = depth_sc, y = yvar)) +
  geom_line(
    data = subset(p_plot, group_type == "Static"),
    aes(group = puppet_cond),
    linewidth = 1.3,
    colour = "grey10",
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = subset(p_plot, group_type == "Drifting"),
    aes(colour = cond_dir, group = puppet_cond),
    linewidth = 0.95,
    linetype = "22",
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(p_plot_end, group_type == "Drifting"),
    aes(label = slant_target_label, colour = cond_dir),
    direction = "y",
    nudge_x = 0.03,
    nudge_y = p_plot_end$label_nudge_y,
    size = 3,
    segment.alpha = 0.4,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(~ slant_start_label) +
  labs(x = "Depth", y = "Predicted MRS", colour = "Drift direction") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dir_cols, breaks = c("left", "right")) +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 0.6
  )
```

``` {r drift model residuals}

res <- simulateResiduals(md)

testUniformity(res)
testOutliers(res)
plot(res)

mf <- model.frame(md)

#res_by_id <- recalculateResiduals(res_util, group = mf$puppet_id)

testTemporalAutocorrelation(
  res_by_depth,
  time = sort(unique(mf$depth))
)
```
